exact_definition: Organic or ex-Tyman revenue and unit volume by segment/geography versus prior year and approved case.
warning_threshold: below -5% year over year or 5% below approved case
required_borrower_response: Explain variance and provide revised demand bridge.
lender_action: Reconcile within 10 business days; require monthly volume reporting if unresolved.
limitation: Comparable volume requires borrower reporting.

exact_definition: Segment price/mix benefit less raw-material and index cost movement.
required_borrower_response: Provide pass-through actions and customer/mix explanation.
lender_action: Request corrective pricing plan within 10 business days.
limitation: Public reporting does not isolate all effects.

exact_definition: Consolidated gross profit divided by revenue, with segment and plant bridge.
required_report_or_source: Monthly management accounts and plant operating report
required_borrower_response: Provide plant, mix and fixed-cost bridge.
lender_action: Increase reporting frequency and require a 30-day margin action plan.
limitation: Acquisition mix and seasonality affect comparisons.

exact_definition: LTM lender-base EBITDA using the approved adjustment register, separately reconciled to company and contractual measures.
required_report_or_source: Monthly EBITDA bridge and quarterly compliance certificate
required_borrower_response: Deliver detailed variance and add-back bridge.
lender_action: Require revised projections and monthly lender-base EBITDA reporting.
limitation: Threshold is proposed for owner review and is not contractual.

exact_definition: Company, contractual and lender adjustments by category, cash status, cap and remaining eligibility.
warning_threshold: new composite item or LTM lender adjustments above $40m excluding impairment
required_borrower_response: Provide invoices, cash timing, cap and double-counting analysis.
lender_action: Defer new lender credit pending evidence; escalate certificate exception.
limitation: Contractual eligibility remains separate from lender normalization.

exact_definition: Trailing-twelve-month CFO divided by lender-base EBITDA.
required_borrower_response: Provide cash conversion and working-capital bridge.
lender_action: Require revised cash forecast and monthly working-capital reporting.
limitation: CFO includes cash interest under US GAAP.

exact_definition: CFO less capital expenditure divided by lender-base EBITDA.
required_report_or_source: Cash-flow statement and project-level capex schedule
required_borrower_response: Explain working-capital and capex variance.
lender_action: Require revised liquidity forecast; do not cut maintenance capex without evidence.
limitation: Maintenance versus growth capex remains pending.

exact_definition: Average gross trade receivables divided by revenue times fiscal days.
required_borrower_response: Provide aging, disputes and collection plan.
lender_action: Require weekly collections report if above threshold for two months.
limitation: Acquisition perimeter affects historical comparison.

exact_definition: Average inventory divided by cost of sales times fiscal days.
required_borrower_response: Provide SKU aging, reserve and liquidation plan.
lender_action: Require monthly inventory reduction milestones.
limitation: Mix and acquisition perimeter affect comparability.

metric_or_event: Payables and other operating working capital
exact_definition: AP, accrued liabilities and other operating balances versus approved monthly forecast, separately bridged.
required_report_or_source: Purchases, AP, accrual and other operating working-capital bridge
warning_threshold: variance above 10% from approved forecast or unexplained supplier stretching
required_borrower_response: Provide supplier aging and cash-flow reconciliation.
lender_action: Escalate unexplained funding benefit and revise liquidity forecast.
limitation: Cost of sales is not purchases; DPO remains N/D.

exact_definition: Actual and committed maintenance/safety capex versus approved maintenance floor.
warning_threshold: below approved maintenance floor or deferred safety project
required_borrower_response: Explain deferral and operational effect.
lender_action: Do not credit cash preservation; require project remediation plan.
limitation: Threshold becomes measurable only after borrower schedule.

exact_definition: Eligible unrestricted cash plus undrawn drawable revolver capacity after LCs.
required_report_or_source: Monthly liquidity certificate by entity and jurisdiction
lookback_period: month end and pro forma for material actions
required_borrower_response: Deliver 13-week cash forecast and corrective-action plan.
lender_action: Notify lenders immediately; suspend discretionary actions where documents permit.
limitation: Eligible cash and drawability require final documentation.

exact_definition: Drawn revolver plus LCs divided by commitment.
required_borrower_response: Explain usage and deliver 13-week cash forecast.
lender_action: Increase reporting to weekly and restrict repurchases under proposed terms.
limitation: Availability depends on final draw conditions.

exact_definition: Representations, no-default conditions, covenant compliance and documentation needed for a new draw.
required_borrower_response: Provide cure, waiver request or alternative liquidity plan.
lender_action: Escalate immediately; preserve rights and do not assume continued funding.
limitation: Final conditions and remedies require executed documents.

exact_definition: Gross funded debt divided by lender EBITDA; zero cash netting.
required_report_or_source: Debt report and quarterly compliance certificate
required_borrower_response: Provide covenant bridge and debt-reduction plan.
lender_action: At warning suspend repurchases and require 10-business-day plan; breach requires consent/waiver analysis.
limitation: Official contractual EBITDA remains unavailable.

exact_definition: LTM lender EBITDA divided by LTM cash interest paid or payable.
required_borrower_response: Provide interest bridge, hedge status and revised forecast.
lender_action: Increase reporting and begin amendment/waiver planning before breach.
limitation: Closing LTM cash interest remains N/D.

exact_definition: Timely complete certificate using executed definitions with supporting calculations.
required_borrower_response: Deliver corrected certificate and reconciliation.
lender_action: Issue reporting exception; preserve default rights subject to cure language.
limitation: Final delivery and cure terms require documentation.

exact_definition: Cash due and paid by instrument and due date.
required_borrower_response: Confirm payment, cause, cash position and cure status.
lender_action: Escalate immediately to special-assets/legal review and preserve remedies.
limitation: Grace periods and remedies require final documents.

exact_definition: Dividends and repurchases paid while revolver principal remains outstanding.
required_report_or_source: Distribution, board approval and debt report
warning_threshold: any repurchase with revolver outstanding or debt-funded distribution
required_borrower_response: Provide source of funds and pro forma tests.
lender_action: Reject or require consent where documentation permits; revise deleveraging plan.
limitation: Rights depend on final restricted-payment drafting.

exact_definition: Realized recurring synergies, costs to achieve, service levels and reporting-unit performance versus approved plan.
baseline: $30m claimed realized; remaining $15m receives no Base credit
warning_threshold: less than 80% of milestones on time or two quarters below plan
required_borrower_response: Provide milestone recovery plan and customer impact.
lender_action: No additional EBITDA credit; require monthly steering-committee reporting.
limitation: Synergy quality and sustainability require evidence.

exact_definition: Service, scrap, labor efficiency, downtime and remediation spend for identified plants.
baseline: Mexico hardware stabilization remains a risk
warning_threshold: missed service target or remediation milestone
required_borrower_response: Provide root-cause and recovery plan.
lender_action: Escalate to monthly management call and revise downside case if delayed.
limitation: Public evidence does not provide plant KPI thresholds.

exact_definition: Design, operation and testing status of cash-flow statement controls.
required_report_or_source: Management certification, test evidence and auditor updates
warning_threshold: missed milestone, failed test or new deficiency
required_borrower_response: Provide remediation evidence and auditor communication.
lender_action: Increase reporting, require independent validation and escalate material exceptions.
limitation: The weakness is not treated as a known misstatement.

exact_definition: Delivery of monthly, quarterly and annual reporting, reconciliations and explanations.
warning_threshold: late, incomplete, internally inconsistent or unreconciled report
required_borrower_response: Deliver missing information and explanation.
lender_action: Issue reporting exception and escalate repeated failures to watchlist review.
limitation: Final cure periods require drafting.

metric_or_event: Guarantor, collateral, lien and perfection status
exact_definition: Current legal-entity, guarantor, collateral, lien, control and perfection schedule.
warning_threshold: missing joinder, lapse, release or excluded material asset
required_borrower_response: Provide corrective filing, joinder or legal analysis.
lender_action: Escalate legal exception; preserve conditions and remedies subject to documents.
limitation: Public filings do not establish complete post-Tyman coverage.

exact_definition: Cash by entity/jurisdiction plus currency revenue, cost, debt and hedge exposure.
required_report_or_source: Entity cash and FX exposure schedule
baseline: $46.9m foreign cash at FY2025; no access credit
warning_threshold: material unhedged move or cash-transfer restriction
required_borrower_response: Provide hedge and cash-access analysis.
lender_action: Exclude inaccessible cash and revise liquidity forecast.
limitation: Tax, legal and operating access remain unknown.

exact_definition: Documented refinancing, extension, repayment or committed alternative funding milestones.
required_report_or_source: Board-approved refinancing plan and lender evidence
warning_threshold: no documented plan 24 months before maturity; no executable commitment 12 months before maturity
required_borrower_response: Provide options, timetable, adviser mandate and lender feedback.
lender_action: Watchlist at 24 months without plan; special-assets escalation at 12 months without executable solution.
limitation: Refinancing is not assumed and requires separate underwriting.
